name: Théo Salerno
headline: Investor Relations & Distribution Analyst | Asset Management Sales, Asia-Pacific
location_line: Paris, France (relocating to Hong Kong, available from January 2027)
target: Poste de niveau Analyst / Associate junior (ou VIE / graduate) à Hong Kong, Singapour ou Tokyo, en anglais uniquement : relations investisseurs, levée de fonds, distribution et vente de fonds (wholesale, intermédiaires, wealth, institutionnel), client coverage / relationship, product specialist, client service / RFP-DDQ, corporate access, business development en finance. Secteurs visés : gestion d'actifs, private markets (PE, VC, private credit), hedge funds, wealth management, banques. Veut évoluer vite vers la distribution / la couverture client. Ne veut PAS : postes d'investissement purs (modélisation, deal, analyse de fonds), back-office, conformité, risque, tech, comptabilité.

experience.title: Client Coverage & Investor Relations Analyst
bullets: Support institutional investor and LP relationships on private market strategies (EUR 3bn+ AUM): tailored pitch books, product one-pagers, pre-meeting briefing packs and RFP/DDQ responses, with sign-offs from Investment, Legal and Compliance.
Answer institutional investor enquiries on fund performance, share classes, fees and positioning; co-organised the Annual General Meeting and investor seminars.
Benchmark strategies against peers with fund analytics on S&P Capital IQ and Preqin.
Automated weekly market intelligence with Power Automate and VBA; cleaned large investor databases with VBA and AI tools.

experience.title: Intermediary Distribution & Sales Support Analyst
bullets: Supported distribution across IFAs, wealth managers, family offices and institutional platforms (EUR 700m+ AUM); qualified 45+ meetings, contributing to 5 wealth advisor mandates and 1 wholesale distribution agreement.
Joined client meetings on a Northern Europe roadshow; prepared strategy presentations, pitch materials and briefing packs.
Built monthly flow, AUM, client segmentation and pipeline dashboards for sales management from 5,000+ accounts on Salesforce and Affinity.
Maintained distribution agreement registers, fee schedules and approved marketing materials across 6 funds.

experience.title: Business Development & Strategy Analyst
bullets: Led 60+ B2B client meetings and commercial negotiations, converting 4 accounts; deployed a CRM platform to streamline reporting and consolidate pipeline visibility.

experience.title: Corporate KYC & Client Onboarding Analyst
bullets: Managed end-to-end KYC due diligence, AML/CFT checks and compliance sign-offs for corporate and institutional client onboarding.

experience.title: Strategy & Financial Analyst
bullets: Performed financial due diligence on PE/VC portfolio companies: audited financial models, P&L and valuation assumptions, and stress-tested business plans for investment committee reviews.

education.details: GPA: 3.4/4.0. Coursework: Corporate Finance, Corporate Valuation, Private Equity, Portfolio Management.
International finance and Asia-Pacific capital markets; lived in Tokyo.
Erasmus Exchange Year at Athens University of Economics & Business (Sep 2022 – Jun 2023).

skills.label: Distribution & Client Coverage
skills.text: institutional and wealth client relationships, pipeline management, pitch books and client presentations, RFP/DDQ, fund performance and fee analysis, compliance coordination, KYC/AML.

skills.label: Tools & Data
skills.text: Excel (advanced), VBA, Python, PowerPoint, Power BI, Power Automate, AI tools (Claude), S&P Capital IQ, Preqin, PitchBook, Refinitiv, Salesforce, Affinity.

skills.label: Languages & International
skills.text: English (Fluent, TOEIC 925/990), French (Native), Spanish (Conversational). Lived in Tokyo, Bali and Athens.

skills.label: Interests & Volunteering
skills.text: Classical guitar (14 years), competitive tennis (13 years), rowing; volunteer at Secours Populaire.
